Subject: Bounces as relayhost

Hi,

I got the following problem:
Mail is received our external mx host and relayed to internal customer mail
system. There the mail is distributed to several external mail addresses and
resent via our external mx host. Now it happens, that mail to the external
mail addresses can't be deliverd and a bounce is created on our mx host,
which is not the problem for legitime mail, but for mail from faked
addresses. Our queue keeps up filling with undeliverable bounces
(backscatter?).

Do you have any suggestions how to handle such a situation, when mail is
sometimes accepted by external mail host and sometimes not (think body
checks).

Kind regards
Martin Theiss
